interpretation.denominator: newly completed search simulations; inherited visits excluded
interpretation.cycle_rollouts: expected on-path transposition fallback; counts alone are not failures
interpretation.engine_stop: positive-HP simulator loss, including no-damage and loop-guard stops; not a sampled death
interpretation.turn_limit: simulator loss beyond turn500; classified before HP death
interpretation.nonterminal: unresolved search endpoint, invalid runtime-health evidence
interpretation.limits: Tree counters alone do not distinguish engine-stop causes or establish live-game health, fairness, calibrated win probability or efficacy. No quality threshold or frozen decision rule is changed.
